item.title: Unseasonable warmth returns after a brief taste of winter
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. – The Tetons have received 26-34 inches of snow over the past week, but a warm storm involving subtropical moisture has resulted in rain as high as 8,000 to 9,000 feet on Wednesday. Well-above-average temperatures will prevail from late this week into early next week.
